prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, a long lens straight down a long polished table in a smoky 1930s back room, seen from the far end: a carved ham, a roast bird and champagne bottles loom large and dark in the near foreground. Down both sides of the table, gangsters in pinstripe suits have frozen mid-bite, forks in the air, heads turned to the door: a fat one with a scar through his top lip, a thin bald one with big ears, a young one with slicked red hair and freckles. At the head of the table a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, a napkin tucked in his collar. At the far end the door has burst open: a heavy-set Black baker in his fifties in a sweat-stained vest stands in it, shaved head, broken nose, holding up one small loaf, a dark shape edged in the cold blue of the corridor behind him. One low brass lamp with a green glass shade hangs over the middle of the table, pooling amber on the food; candle stubs in bottles, glowing cigar ends, cigar smoke hanging in flat layers under the lamp. Most of the room in deep brown shadow; the brightest values are the lamp's pool on the food, the spilled champagne on the tabletop and the blue doorway. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
